name: Lapse Blue
block_note: Tagged 'blockable from all sides' (a block works from any direction). The wiki prose calls the follow-up kick unblockable.
combo: combo starter: pull then launch; listed chain Lapse Blue > Rapid Punches > Twofold Kick > Reversal Red
when_it_whiffs: no opponent under the cursor within 35 studs, or the target is blocking
description: Aimed at an opponent within 35 studs; a vacuum drags them to the user, who kicks them upward. Has melee i-frames. Pressing the special (R) after the first kick adds a second kick that slams them into the ground. An undated forum post lists a 14 s cooldown instead of 13 s.

name: Reversal Red
block_note: Blockable; a blocked hit deals half damage (6.25).
air: Air-target variant: when Limitless is used on an airborne target the user kicks them and fires Red straight after (17.5 = 5 kick + 12.5 red); puts the used abilities on cooldown.
combo: combo ender, explosion knocks back
when_it_whiffs: short windup and interruptible; orb stops at 40 studs; half damage into a block
description: After a short windup a red orb travels forward 40 studs and explodes in a 15-stud radius on arrival or contact, repelling whoever is caught. An undated forum post lists a 16 s cooldown; Fandom, NamuWiki and games.gg all say 20 s.

name: Rapid Punches
block_note: Listed as unblockable (Fandom table, NamuWiki). Patch history went back and forth on blocking it during wakeup; the latest note says it is no longer blockable on wakeup.
combo: combo extender; Limitless (R) right after it lands gives the Face Grater drag-and-toss follow-up
when_it_whiffs: the opening kick must connect on a nearby enemy; cannot hit a grounded ragdolled target
description: A spinning kick tries to lock a nearby enemy in place; if it connects the user gains bullet i-frames and the target takes a long string of hits ending in a launch. Has a lingering hitbox since a later patch.

name: Twofold Kick
block_note: Semi-blockable: the first kick can be blocked, the second kick is unblockable.
combo: launcher; second kick always follows a landed first kick
when_it_whiffs: first kick blocked or out of melee range
description: An upward kick anchors the enemy in the air, then an automatic second kick bounces them higher. While awakened the user then holds the enemy and fires a point-blank Reversal Red (10 damage, melee i-frames). V1.68 cut the cooldown by 2 s, raised the launch height and removed melee invincibility on startup.

name: Limitless
block_note: Tagged unblockable and interruptible.
damage: 0 (Limitless Air kick 8; Face Grater follow-up 10.2 over 3 hits per NamuWiki)
air: On an airborne target the user appears above them and kicks them to the floor (Limitless Air: 8 damage, short true ragdoll).
combo: gap closer and extender; after Rapid Punches it becomes Face Grater, after Lapse Blue's first kick it adds a slam
when_it_whiffs: needs an enemy under the cursor; interruptible
description: With an enemy under the cursor the user teleports in front of them; turning the camera before the glass-shatter effect ends chooses where around the target the user appears. Deals no damage on its own. One wiki version block shows a 6% awakening cost; an undated community post mentions a 3 s cooldown, the wiki and NamuWiki say 15 s.

name: Lapse Blue MAX
block_note: Listed as unblockable (games.gg: '44 unblockable damage').
damage: about 44 total (2.2 per tick x 20 ticks)
combo: groups enemies; sets up Unlimited Purple after a kill
when_it_whiffs: interruptible; pulled enemies can ragdoll-cancel away as soon as they are pulled
description: Creates a vortex that lasts 20 ticks and pulls in nearby targets, damaging each tick (2.2 per tick). If it kills someone, half the base damage is spread to every other player it pulled, and it leaves an orb; hitting that orb with Reversal Red MAX makes Unlimited Purple (explodes after 3 s, 50-100 damage by distance from the centre, drains the whole awakening bar).

name: Reversal Red MAX
block_note: Tagged unblockable and interruptible.
combo: ranged poke; detonates a Lapse Blue MAX orb into Unlimited Purple
when_it_whiffs: interruptible; damage falls off with distance
description: A piercing red projectile that passes through enemies and dissipates at 100 studs, dealing less the farther it has travelled. Fandom lists 30 down to 7 damage; NamuWiki lists roughly 5 to 34.4 plus 10. One guide says a missed orb deals 15 damage to the user.

name: Hollow Purple
block_note: Tagged unblockable and uninterruptible; explosion damage.
combo: finisher; needs a setup because of the charge time
when_it_whiffs: about 3 s charge before release; the hitbox does not cover the gap directly in front of the user
description: The user charges for about 3 seconds, then releases a purple mass that rushes forward and erases anything in its path. A finisher version (a Lapse Blue MAX finisher shot with Reversal Red MAX) is an instant kill.

name: Infinite Void
block_note: Tagged unblockable, interruptible, bypasses ragdoll, true ragdoll.
combo: long guaranteed stun for free follow-ups
when_it_whiffs: interruptible while casting; the stun does not interrupt actions started before the sure-hit began
description: Domain expansion with no direct damage: anyone caught is stunned (cannot move, dash, attack, block or use skills) until the domain ends. Fandom and games.gg give a 14 s duration; NamuWiki's body text says about 10 s. Mahoraga's Adaptation grants immunity to its sure-hit.

name: Cursed Strikes
block_note: Tagged 'blockable from all sides'; blocking it cuts the slide short.
air: Used airborne it becomes a diving dropkick that grounds the target; it cannot be aimed straight down or feinted after the hop.
combo: extender tied to M1 resets
when_it_whiffs: blocked from any side; cannot hit a ragdolled target
description: A forward sliding melee string; if it is blocked the slide is cut short. Sources disagree: NamuWiki (edited more recently) lists 17.5 damage and an 18 s cooldown, Fandom lists 14 damage and 14 s; Fandom's log says V1.70 raised its cooldown and its M1-reset detection.

name: Crushing Blow
block_note: Ground version is unblockable; the air version is blockable from all sides.
damage: 12 total (6 per slam x2); 3 for the miss shockwave; NamuWiki lists 10 for the air version
air: Air variant exists and is blockable from all sides (interruptible, still bypasses ragdoll).
combo: unblockable opener or extender; hits downed targets
when_it_whiffs: a miss gives only a 3-damage shockwave with no stun; interruptible
description: Slams the target twice. If nothing is caught only a weaker shockwave comes out, and that shockwave no longer stuns. The finisher version is a slam into a German suplex for an instant kill.

name: Divergent Fist
block_note: Tagged semi-blockable (only part of it can be blocked); the finisher is unblockable.
damage: 10 (5 per hit x2); Black Flash 10, or 20 on interrupting an action
combo: punish tool: Black Flash rewards catching an enemy mid-action
when_it_whiffs: tagged 'partly bypasses ragdoll', so part of it misses downed targets; windup can be blocked
description: A wound-up punch that hits twice. Pressing the key again while the fist is pulled back turns it into Black Flash, which doubles the damage (20) when it interrupts an enemy's action other than blocking. The finisher version is unblockable and an instant kill.

name: Manji Kick
block_note: The counter hit is tagged unblockable.
combo: defensive reversal, knocks the attacker away
when_it_whiffs: does nothing unless the user is hit by a melee or bullet attack inside the 0.6 s window
description: Counter stance with a 0.6 s window. Hit by a melee attack, the user answers with a roundhouse kick that knocks the attacker aside; hit by a bullet attack, the user evades it and swoops in on the attacker while spinning. It once countered every attack; that was patched back.

name: Combat Instincts
combo: bait: cancel a windup to draw out a block or counter
when_it_whiffs: only does something during an M1 or skill windup
description: A feint: used during an M1 or skill windup it cancels that attack with no endlag and keeps the move off cooldown. A throwable variant costs 3% awakening and deals 15 damage. Since V1.62 it takes awakening when used but does not require it.

name: Cleave
combo: best on a high-HP target; execute when it can finish
when_it_whiffs: cannot hit a grounded ragdolled target
description: Awakening special. Deals 40% of the target's current HP with a floor of 10 damage; the finisher version is an instant kill. The excerpt gave numbers and tags only, so 'melee' is my reading of the 'cannot bypass grounded ragdoll' tag.

name: Dismantle
block_note: Blocking cuts it to 10 total (1 per tick) and prevents the execute.
damage: 17.5 total (1.75 per tick); 10 on block; NamuWiki: air variant 25
air: NamuWiki lists an air variant dealing 25.
combo: ranged pressure / chip
when_it_whiffs: target beyond 30 studs; much weaker into a block
description: A multi-tick slashing attack that hits opponents within 30 studs (NamuWiki calls it a ranged skill and lists a 25-damage air variant). Blocking opponents take reduced damage and cannot be executed by it. 'projectile' is my reading of 'ranged'.

name: Open
block_note: Blockability was not stated in the excerpt.
combo: launcher: the pillar lifts targets
description: The user gains total i-frames, then fires a flame arrow; on impact it creates a fire pillar that lifts whoever is in range.

name: Rush
combo: gap closer that can be extended
description: A distance-covering charge: an impact hit, a kick, then a slam. Community notes say it can be extended off of. Its block and ragdoll tags were not in the excerpts.

name: Malevolent Shrine
block_note: Blocking cuts each slash from 2 to 0.5 HP and prevents executions.
damage: 2 per slash, 156 over 78 slashes (0.5 per slash on block)
combo: area denial; kills unblocking targets outright
when_it_whiffs: targets who hold block take a quarter damage
description: Domain that lasts 12 s and slashes everyone inside 78 times. Blocking reduces each slash and prevents the execute. The awakening itself (King of Curses) heals 45 HP and lasts 60 s.

name: Reserve Balls
block_note: Tagged blockable and interruptible; bullet damage.
damage: 7.5 (NamuWiki); 13.5 total with the Shutter Doors variant
combo: ranged starter: stun at range, ragdoll up close; counts as a 'visual move' in Idle Death Gamble
when_it_whiffs: blockable; ball disappears after 65 studs
description: Flicks a small steel ball that travels 65 studs forward. A hit briefly stuns, but at 15 studs or less it ragdolls instead. Using Shutter Doors during the windup makes the doors appear where the ball lands or at max range (13.5 total, both moves go on cooldown, and it ragdolls).

name: Shutter Doors
block_note: Tagged blockable and interruptible.
damage: 8; miss variant 6 total over three bounces
combo: combos with Reserve Balls and Fever Breaker (Fever Crush)
when_it_whiffs: base hit cannot reach a ragdolled target; on a miss it becomes a 7 s lingering trap that does hit ragdolled targets
description: Shutter doors strike the target (NamuWiki classes it as a melee skill). If it misses, the doors linger for 7 seconds and bounce anyone who touches them. The Escapist lists a 10 s cooldown; Fandom and NamuWiki say 15 s.

name: Rough Energy
block_note: Ground punch is unblockable. The air stomp is blockable from all sides, unless used from higher than jump height, which makes it unblockable.
damage: 12.5 ground; 8 air; 16 from above jump height
air: Air variant: stomp, 8 damage, blockable. From above jump height: 16 damage, unblockable.
combo: guard break; knocks back, air version launches upward
when_it_whiffs: slow windup and interruptible; the normal air version can be blocked
description: The user winds up and punches with cursed energy, sending the enemy flying; NamuWiki notes a long startup. Used in the air the user hovers briefly and stomps, and the shockwave launches targets upward.

name: Fever Breaker
block_note: Tagged blockable and interruptible; Fever Crush is semi-blockable.
damage: 15 total (5 kick + 10 dropkick); Fever Crush 20 (8 doors + 12 stomp), 26 vs ragdolled
combo: combo ender; the dropkick and Fever Crush count as 'visual moves' in Idle Death Gamble
when_it_whiffs: blockable; cannot hit a grounded ragdolled target
description: A kick followed by a dropkick, with bullet i-frames. Combined with Shutter Doors it becomes Fever Crush (doors then a stomp: 20 total, 26 on a ragdolled target, semi-blockable, both moves go on cooldown). Fandom lists a 23 s cooldown (set in V1.55); NamuWiki lists 14 s.

name: Door Guard
combo: defensive reversal; a successful counter counts as a 'visual move' in Idle Death Gamble
when_it_whiffs: needs the opponent to attack into it; only melee attackers take damage
description: Raises shutter doors in front as a counter stance. A melee hit is answered by punching through the doors and repelling the attacker; a bullet hit only shatters the doors. Cooldown was raised in V1.67.

name: Rhythm
combo: use in downtime to shorten cooldowns
when_it_whiffs: if the dance is interrupted no buff is gained
description: Awakening special: a dance. Dancing to the beat gives a stackable, permanent speed boost to moves and specials, and moves on cooldown finish 0.6 s sooner. The wiki text says execution stacks are removed while the V1.69 note says Rhythm now regenerates execution stacks; the excerpts did not settle which is current.

name: Lucky Volley
block_note: Semi-blockable: the barrage can be blocked, the final swipe is unblockable.
combo: extender after uppercut or downslam; final hit launches
when_it_whiffs: barrage hits can be blocked; interruptible
description: A barrage of nine punches the user can walk around during, ending in a strong swipe that launches the enemy. Bypasses ragdoll since V1.76. A guide suggests using it after an uppercut or downslam and flicking the camera so the last hit misses, to continue with M1s.

name: Lucky Rushdown
block_note: Tagged unblockable and interruptible.
combo: unblockable approach, throws the target forward
when_it_whiffs: runs in a straight line and catches only what it runs into; interruptible
description: A long forward run; if it meets an enemy the user grabs them by the leg, drags them across the floor and throws them forward. Disables lock-on. A fan concept page lists it as blockable with 14.5 damage, which does not match the wiki.

name: Overwhelming Luck
combo: high-damage rush string
when_it_whiffs: charge-up before the rush
description: The user charges cursed energy (gaining bullet i-frames), then rushes forward with a heavy strike that ragdolls the target, followed by a kick, three punches and a double palm strike. It can hit more than one person. Its block tag was not in the excerpts; one guide says it deals 30 on the hits after the first.

name: Energy Surge
block_note: Tagged unblockable.
combo: launcher; follow-up kick lands on one target only
description: A dash into a heavy punch that launches the target upward, followed by a kick. The first hit can send several people flying but only one of them receives the follow-up.

name: Rabbit Escape
block_note: Fandom: blockable from all sides. The Lurking Shadow variant is unblockable but counterable.
combo: root that sets up a follow-up; note Nue cannot be summoned while the rabbits are swarming a grounded target
when_it_whiffs: no enemy within 40 studs; being hit or stunned during the hand sign stops the rabbits from spawning
description: With an enemy within 40 studs the user makes a hand sign and a swarm of rabbits buries the target's lower body, so they cannot walk or dash until the rabbits are gone. Used from inside Lurking Shadow the user instead hops out of the puddle and knocks nearby enemies away (14 damage, unblockable, but it counts as melee so it can be countered). The newer wiki page does not show the 'blockable from all sides' tag that the Fandom page has.

name: Nue
block_note: Tagged unblockable (swarm damage). The fly variant is semi-blockable: airborne targets can block it.
air: Special-during-windup variant carries the user through the air on Nue.
combo: hits downed targets; the fly variant doubles as an escape
when_it_whiffs: cannot be summoned while Rabbit Escape is swarming a grounded target; interruptible
description: Summons Nue to strike the target with a shocking true-ragdoll hit; it flies faster at a ragdolled enemy. Pressing the special during the windup makes the user grab Nue's leg and fly for a short time; that version can be blocked from all sides by airborne targets and has a 22 s cooldown (10 s on the special).

name: Toad
block_note: Tagged blockable and interruptible (swarm type).
combo: long-range starter: pulls the target in
when_it_whiffs: no opponent under the aim within 75 studs; blockable
description: Aimed at an opponent within 75 studs; a giant frog appears at the user's left side, wraps its tongue around the target and pulls them to itself. Deals no damage. Using Nue during Toad's startup gives Well's Unknown Abyss (12 damage; does not need Nue off cooldown and does not put it on cooldown).

name: Divine Dog: Totality
block_note: Tagged blockable from all sides; bullet damage.
combo: three separate knock-away hits on command
when_it_whiffs: no enemy within 50 studs of the dog; dog is lost if the user gets ragdolled
description: The first use summons the Divine Dog; each of the next three uses orders it to attack the closest enemy within 50 studs, ragdolling them away. The dog is dispelled after its third attack or if the user is ragdolled. Usable from inside Lurking Shadow. The excerpts read the damage two ways: 18 total at 6 per attack (rblxguide), or 18 on first use plus 6 per later use.

name: Lurking Shadow
combo: evasive tool; enables the unblockable Rabbit Escape hop-out
description: The user sinks into their own shadow and stays there for 1.15 seconds. Rabbit Escape and Divine Dog: Totality can still be used from inside. If an item or throwable is held, it is stored in the shadow instead. Ten Shadows has 85 HP rather than 100.

name: Max Elephant
block_note: Tagged unblockable and interruptible.
combo: heavy unblockable hit, true ragdoll
when_it_whiffs: interruptible
description: Awakening move tagged true ragdoll and explosion damage; the finisher version is an instant kill. A fan blog says victims cannot ragdoll-cancel out of it. The excerpts gave tags and numbers only, not how the hit is delivered, so 'summon' is my reading of the name.

name: Great Serpent
block_note: Tagged unblockable and interruptible.
damage: 29 plus poison 2.9 per second for 10 s
combo: unblockable grab with damage over time, true ragdoll
when_it_whiffs: interruptible
description: A serpent grabs the enemy; anyone grabbed is poisoned for 10 seconds. Disables lock-on. The patch history says the grab damage was later reduced to 0 and the poison tick raised, so the 29 figure may be stale.

name: Shadow Swarm
block_note: Tagged unblockable, interruptible, melee.
combo: unblockable close-range string; anti-domain tool
when_it_whiffs: interruptible; the domain-invasion variant costs the user 4 HP per second
description: A grab into a barrage with a final hit. Fandom splits the 18 as 6 grab + 7 barrage + 5 bat; rblxguide as 13 barrage + 5 last hit. Used against a domain's border it instead invades that domain (Chimera Shadow Garden), disabling several sure-hit effects while draining the user's HP by 4 per second until closed; rblxguide lists a 30 s cooldown for that variant.

name: Mahoraga
block_note: Tagged unblockable and interruptible.
combo: transformation, not a damage move
when_it_whiffs: no opponent within 60 studs; fails if the user is interrupted during the 3 s ritual
description: Targets an opponent within 60 studs and starts a three-second summoning ritual; if it is not interrupted the user summons Mahoraga and takes control of it, switching to the Mahoraga moveset. Costs 40% awakening (listed as not required). The ritual bar starts between 40% and 100% depending on awakening progress.

name: Divine Pummel
block_note: Tagged unblockable and interruptible; melee damage.
combo: unblockable close-range opener; landing it refills the ritual
when_it_whiffs: interruptible; may not hit ragdolled targets on the current patch
description: Grabs the target, slams them repeatedly and finishes with a punch. The Fandom page also tags it 'bypasses ragdoll'; the newer wiki page (updated October 2026) omits that tag.

name: Ground Pitch
block_note: Tagged unblockable and interruptible.
combo: ranged follow-up after a close grab
when_it_whiffs: cancelled if nothing is picked up near the user
description: Picks up a target near the user and throws debris at the nearest enemy in view. Since V1.74 the move is cancelled if nothing was picked up. The finisher version is an instant kill. Landing it does not refill the ritual.

name: Earthquake
block_note: Tap version is blockable; the held version is unblockable.
combo: held version launches enemies for a follow-up
when_it_whiffs: tap version can be blocked; interruptible while charging
description: A shockwave around the user. Holding the input for roughly 0.8-0.9 s releases a larger shockwave that lifts enemies and cannot be blocked.

name: Takedown
block_note: Tagged unblockable and interruptible.
combo: gap closer and launcher; cheap to repeat when it lands
when_it_whiffs: no opponent within 70 studs; a miss doubles the cooldown
description: Targets an opponent within 70 studs and launches them with an uppercut. The cooldown is 7 s if it lands and 15 s if it misses.

name: Adaptation
cooldown_s: 5 if missed, 2 if landed, 15 on special domain expansions
combo: defensive; builds damage reduction
when_it_whiffs: needs to be hit inside the 0.4 s window
description: Defense-mode move: the user drops his guard as the wheel glows, with a 0.4 s counter window. A successful counter heals 15 HP and adapts to that attack type (10% damage reduction; the older Fandom page says +20% per repeat up to 70%). Adapting to Infinite Void or Shining Sea of Growing Branches gives immunity to their sure-hit for that domain's duration.

name: World Slash
block_note: Tagged unblockable and interruptible.
combo: finisher
when_it_whiffs: long windup, interruptible
description: A 40-damage slash tagged explosion damage, with a long windup and a 30 s cooldown whether or not it lands. The finisher is an instant kill. Landing it does not refill the ritual. The excerpts did not describe its travel or hitbox, so 'projectile' is my reading of the name.

name: Adaptation Wheel
combo: mode switch, no hit
description: Mahoraga's special. Three modes (Attack, Defense, Special): each press of the awakening button cycles the selection, and the special button confirms it or quick-swaps to the next mode if the current one is already confirmed. The mode decides the fourth move (Adaptation is the Defense-mode move); switching while that slot is on cooldown does not give a fresh move.

name: Stockpile
block_note: Semi-blockable: first swing blockable, second swing unblockable. The air variant is fully unblockable.
air: Air variant: the user hops and slams down with a flesh hammer; unblockable, interruptible, bypasses ragdoll, 10 damage.
combo: two-hit string; the air slam hits downed targets
when_it_whiffs: first swing can be blocked and does not hit ragdolled targets (tagged 'partly bypasses ragdoll')
description: Two hammer swings. The changelog says the first hit is blockable and no longer bypasses ragdoll; the second swing is unblockable. The finisher version is an instant kill.

name: Soul Fire
block_note: Tagged blockable and interruptible; only from the front since the 360-degree block was removed.
combo: ranged poke; last bullet ragdolls
when_it_whiffs: blockable; interruptible
description: Fires three bullets; the final bullet causes ragdoll. Holding the key fires stored transfigured humans or flesh as extra bullets (4 damage each, consumed from the fourth bullet on). No longer blockable from all sides.

name: Focus Strike
block_note: Base hit is blockable (front only since the 360-degree block was removed); the Black Flash follow-up is unblockable.
combo: does not reset M1s; Black Flash variant is a knock-away finisher
when_it_whiffs: base hit is blockable and cannot hit a grounded ragdolled target
description: A wound-up punch that does not reset M1s. Pressing the key again while the arm is fully wound back turns it into a Black Flash if it lands: 12 damage, unblockable, bypasses ragdoll and sends the target flying. Older posts list 8 damage and 18 s; the patch history shows damage raised from 6 to 10 and cooldown 12 s to 15 s.

name: Body Repel
block_note: Tagged unblockable and interruptible; swarm damage.
combo: unblockable ranged hit, reaches downed targets
when_it_whiffs: travels only where the user is facing; interruptible
description: Sends out a swarm attack along the direction the user is facing; it always travels 70 studs before disappearing. A variant combined with Focus Strike neither requires Focus Strike to be off cooldown nor puts it on cooldown.

name: Self Transfiguration
description: Not researched: the session's web-search budget ran out before this move was looked up, and the wiki pages could not be opened directly. The only special found for Perfection was 'Soul Reserves': using the special while holding a transfigured human or flesh stores it, and M1 while blocking pulls stored items back out.
